name: cpp-mastery-hub
description: Research-grade C++ learning platform: dependency-free analysis engine, Next.js front end, Express/Prisma API.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:cpp-engine"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:cpp-engine
scripts.build:cpp-engine: cd cpp-engine && cmake --preset release && cmake --build --preset release
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:cpp-engine
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:frontend -- --fix && npm run lint:backend -- --fix
scripts.format: npm run format:frontend && npm run format:backend && npm run format:cpp-engine
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.clean: npm run clean:frontend && npm run clean:backend && npm run clean:cpp-engine
scripts.clean:frontend: cd frontend && rm -rf .next dist build node_modules/.cache
scripts.clean:backend: cd backend && rm -rf dist build node_modules/.cache
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup:dev: npm run install:all && npm run docker:dev && sleep 10 && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && npm run docker:build && npm run docker:up
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && npm run docker:prod
scripts.security:audit: npm audit && cd frontend && npm audit && cd ../backend && npm audit
scripts.security:fix: npm audit fix && cd frontend && npm audit fix && cd ../backend && npm audit fix
scripts.health:check: npm run health:frontend && npm run health:backend && npm run health:cpp-engine
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --workspace frontend && npm run type-check --workspace backend
